company.name: PromptArmor
company.shortDescription: PromptArmor develops an AI management platform that monitors third-party AI systems, detects LLM security risks, and supports AI governance.
company.description: PromptArmor develops an AI risk management platform that helps organizations assess and monitor security risks across third-party AI systems. Its platform continuously analyzes large language model interactions, detects prompt injection and data exfiltration threats, and provides technical intelligence and risk scoring, enabling enterprises to strengthen AI governance, compliance, and vendor security.
